title: The dark tunnel
goals: Walk out at the tunnel's other end, cell (19, 1).
starting_code:
# Print where you stand with `position` and `print`.

# Walk up to the exit's row with `move_up`.

# Walk right to the end with `move_right`.
hints: Use `print` to see where you are in this dark place!
The plan shows the exit at (19, 1), but we cannot see ourselves. Use `wizard.position`.
If we are at (15, 3), we need to go 2 steps up and 4 steps right.
intro: It's so dark! The tunnel is enchanted, and neither our eyes nor the map can see us. We won't see anything move. But the map says the other end is at cell (19, 1). We can ask the program where we stand, count the steps, and walk blind!
outro: Phew, that was spooky! But asking the program worked, and we are out.
learned: Now you know why a program asks where it is instead of looking.
